notes: Official 2026 USMLE Biostatistics outline explicitly lists noninferiority/equivalence trials.
FDA Non-Inferiority Clinical Trials final guidance (November 2016) remains the current FDA guidance page and directly addresses NI margins and confidence-interval hypothesis testing.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: For new-minus-standard success difference with NI margin -5%, a 95% CI of -3.4% to +1.0% lies entirely above the NI boundary but crosses zero: noninferior, not superior.
adversarial_second_pass.inferior_attack: A point estimate modestly favoring control does not establish inferiority when the full interval remains above the prespecified NI margin.
adversarial_second_pass.superiority_attack: Crossing zero prevents a superiority conclusion.
adversarial_second_pass.zero_attack: Crossing zero is compatible with noninferiority; the relevant boundary is the prespecified NI margin.
adversarial_second_pass.equivalence_attack: A successful one-sided NI framework does not by itself prove two-sided equivalence.
adversarial_second_pass.arithmetic_check: All interval directions and signs were independently recomputed before PASS.
